
  :root { --pink:#E7503F; --line:#9F9F9F; --card:#23374B; }
  * { box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body { margin:0; background:#fff; }
  body { font-family:'Aleo', Georgia, serif; color:#000; }
  .story { position:relative; background:#E7EEF8; }
  .story-tail { height:100vh; }
  .stage { transform-origin:50% 0; }
  .sheetshade { position:absolute; inset:0; background:#0d0f12; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:6; }
  .stage { position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow:hidden; }
  .scene { position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; will-change:opacity; contain:strict; }
  .scene:not(.on) { visibility:hidden; }
  .scene.on { opacity:1; }
  .scene:not(.on) * { animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .art { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; will-change:transform; }
  .paper { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; mix-blend-mode:multiply; opacity:.9; }
  .paper { background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover no-repeat; }

  /* timeline (from Figma: line x=80.5, dot 20px at y=95, label x=107) */
  .cover { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:1; will-change:opacity; }
  .cover .cover-cup { transform-box:view-box; transform-origin:756px 600px; will-change:transform; }
  .cover .cover-title, .cover .cover-scatter, .cover .cover-steam { will-change:opacity, transform; }
  .cover.gone { visibility:hidden; }
  .cover.gone * { animation-play-state:paused !important; }
  .chapter { position:absolute; left:50%; top:46%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); z-index:2; pointer-events:none; text-align:center; width:min(90vw,760px); will-change:opacity, transform, filter; }
  .ch-year { margin:0; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,84px); line-height:1.05; color:#1f1a14;
     text-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(239,227,198,.95), 0 0 6px rgba(239,227,198,.9); }
  .ch-sub { margin:10px 0 0; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(24px,2.6vw,38px); line-height:1.2; color:#1f1a14;
     text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(239,227,198,.95), 0 0 5px rgba(239,227,198,.9); }
  .article { position:relative; z-index:5; background:#E7EEF8; padding:20vh 0 22vh; margin-top:-100vh; }
  .article-next { position:relative; z-index:5; background:#E7EEF8; padding:4vh 0 6vh; }
  .article-col { width:min(860px, 92vw); margin:0 auto; background:transparent; padding:72px 84px 64px; }
  .article-col h2 { margin:0 0 44px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:40px; line-height:1.12; color:#1f1f1f; font-weight:400; }
  .article-col h2 b { display:block; font-weight:700; } .article-col h2 span { display:block; color:#3a3a3a; }
  .article-col p { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:18px; line-height:1.7; color:#222; margin:0 0 22px; }
  @media (max-width:700px) { .article-col { padding:44px 26px; } .article-col h2 { font-size:30px; } .article-col p { font-size:16px; } }
    .chartcard { position:relative; margin:56px 0 0; width:100%; background:transparent;
     padding:0; }
  .chartcard h3 { margin:0 0 14px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:28px; color:#2b2b2b; letter-spacing:-.3px; }
  .cc-legend { display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:center; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:12.5px; color:#3a2a2a; margin-bottom:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .cc-legend i { display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; margin-right:8px; vertical-align:-3px; }
  .cc-legend em { font-style:normal; color:#8a8484; margin-left:auto; font-size:12px; }
  .cc-svg { width:100%; height:auto; display:block; overflow:visible; position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .cc-plot { position:relative; }
  .cc-pin { position:relative; height:280vh; margin-top:6vh; }
  .cc-sticky { position:sticky; top:max(14px, calc(50vh - 330px)); }
  .cc-pin .chartcard { margin-top:0; }
  .cc-dots { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; }
  .cc-read { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:22px; margin:10px 0 4px; font-family:Tahoma, Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif; font-size:12.5px; color:#3a2a2a; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .cc-read i { display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; margin-right:7px; vertical-align:-1px; }
  .cc-legend span b { font-weight:700; font-size:15px; margin-left:4px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .cc-rs b { color:#E7503F; } .cc-rh b { color:#4c8fc0; }
  .cc-legend .cc-ryr { font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif !important; font-weight:700 !important; font-size:30px; color:#2b2b2b; min-width:76px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .cc-ax { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:11px; fill:#6b6262; }
  .cc-big { font-family:'Bree Serif',Georgia,serif !important; font-size:30px; font-weight:700; paint-order:stroke; stroke:#E7EEF8; stroke-width:6px; stroke-linejoin:round; }
  .cc-pct { font-size:17px; }
  .cc-year { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:64px; fill:#2b2b2b; opacity:.07; }
  .ccn, .cc-end { opacity:0; transition:opacity .45s; } .ccn.on, .cc-end.on { opacity:1; }
  .cc-note { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:11.5px; fill:#2b2b2b; }
  .cc-line { stroke-dasharray:1; stroke-dashoffset:1; transition:stroke-dashoffset 2.6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); }
  .chartcard.drawn .cc-line { stroke-dashoffset:0; }
  .cc-marks { opacity:0; transition:opacity .8s 2.2s; } .chartcard.drawn .cc-marks { opacity:1; }
  .cc-pt { cursor:pointer; }
  .cc-tip { position:absolute; pointer-events:none; background:#fff; border:1px solid #ddd; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12); padding:7px 10px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.35; max-width:250px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s; }
  .hairline { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:200vmax; height:1px; background:#2c3a7e; transform-origin:0 0; z-index:5; pointer-events:none; opacity:.55; }
  @keyframes cvdrift { 0%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0) } 50% { transform:translate(14px,-10px) rotate(8deg) } }
  @keyframes cvbreathe { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1) } 50% { transform:scale(1.015) } }
  @keyframes cvglow { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1); opacity:.9 } 50% { transform:scale(1.08); opacity:1 } }
  @keyframes cvdash { 0%,100% { transform:translateX(0); opacity:.9 } 50% { transform:translateX(10px); opacity:.65 } }
  .cv-drift { animation:cvdrift 9s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; }
  .cv-rims { animation:cvbreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite; } .cv-rims-a { animation:cvbreathe 8s ease-in-out infinite -2s; }
  .cv-glow { animation:cvglow 7s ease-in-out infinite; } .cv-dashes { animation:cvdash 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .cv-world, .cv-text { transform-box:view-box; transform-origin:930px 491px; will-change:transform, opacity, filter; }
  .wipe { position:absolute; left:53%; top:75%; width:0; height:0; border-radius:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); z-index:5; pointer-events:none; border:2px solid #fff; box-shadow:0 0 40px 16px rgba(255,255,255,.85), inset 0 0 40px 16px rgba(255,255,255,.85); opacity:0; }
  .chart { position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b9c8e2,#d6deee 55%,#c3d0e6); clip-path:circle(0 at 53% 75%); z-index:4; }
  .chart svg { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }
  .chart .ctitle { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:48px; fill:#2c3a7e; }
  .chart .csub { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:20px; fill:#2c3a7e; opacity:.8; }
  .chart .ax { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:16px; fill:#2c3a7e; opacity:.85; }
  .chart .lab { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:21px; }
  .chart .bigyear { font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:170px; fill:#2c3a7e; opacity:.1; }
  .chart .note { opacity:0; transition:opacity .6s; } .chart .note.on { opacity:1; }
  .notecard { background:rgba(250,251,254,.72); backdrop-filter:blur(6px); border:1px solid #fff; color:#2c3a7e !important; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.38; padding:10px 13px; color:#000; }
  .chart .pt { opacity:0; transition:opacity .4s; cursor:pointer; } .chart.done .pt { opacity:1; }
  .chart .endlab { transition:opacity .6s; }
  .tip { position:absolute; pointer-events:none; background:rgba(250,251,254,.92); border:1px solid #fff; color:#2c3a7e; padding:8px 11px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:14px; line-height:1.35; max-width:260px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(62,48,36,.18); }
  .track { position:absolute; left:0; top:95px; will-change:transform; }
  .mark { position:absolute; left:71px; height:20px; display:flex; align-items:center; transition:opacity .4s; }
  .tick { position:absolute; left:76px; width:9px; height:1.5px; margin-top:9px; background:#6f6a62; transition:opacity .4s; }
  .tick.big { left:72px; width:17px; height:2px; }
  .tick i { position:absolute; left:28px; top:-8px; font-style:normal; font-size:12px; line-height:16px; color:#5f5a52; white-space:nowrap; text-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(239,227,198,.95); }
  .dot { width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--pink); flex:none; }
  .yr { margin-left:16px; font-size:24px; line-height:32px; white-space:nowrap; text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(239,227,198,.9); }

  .cards { position:relative; margin-top:-100vh; padding:320vh 0 190vh; z-index:2; }
  .card { width:474px; max-width:calc(100vw - 48px); min-height:218px; margin:0 auto 95vh; background:var(--card);
           display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:26px 34px; }
  .card:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }

  /* cover: title on paper, the globe rises and zooms into China, then the timeline begins */
  .cover2 { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:8; background:#98BDE4; overflow:hidden; will-change:opacity; }
  .cv2-svg { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }
  .cv2-paper { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; mix-blend-mode:multiply; opacity:.28; background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center/cover no-repeat; }
  .cv2-vig { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%, rgba(255,255,255,.28) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 45%, rgba(35,55,75,.22) 100%); }
  .cv2-title { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:min(92vw, 760px); text-align:center; will-change:transform, opacity; }
  .cv2-title h1 { margin:0; font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(52px, 7vw, 104px); line-height:1; color:#23374B; letter-spacing:-.01em;
    animation:cv2in 1.2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.25,1) both; }
  .cv2-title p { margin:16px auto 0; max-width:34em; font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size:clamp(15px, 1.25vw, 18px); line-height:1.45; color:#282828;
    animation:cv2in 1.2s .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.25,1) both; }
  .c2-lab { font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight:700; font-size:34px; letter-spacing:.14em; fill:#fff; }
  .cv2-hint { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:22px; transform:translateX(-50%); font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size:14px; color:#23374B; opacity:.85;
    animation:cv2bob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes cv2in { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px); } to { opacity:1; transform:none; } }
  @keyframes cv2bob { 50% { transform:translate(-50%, 5px); } }
  .cards > .card.mapgap { margin-bottom:200vh; }
  .card p { margin:0; font-size:18px; line-height:1.42; text-align:center; text-wrap:pretty; }
  .card p u { text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:3px; }
  .hint { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:28px; transform:translateX(-50%); font-size:15px; color:#5a4630; opacity:.8; transition:opacity .5s; z-index:3;
           text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(239,227,198,.9); }
  @media (max-width:700px) { .card { min-height:0; padding:20px 22px; } .card p { font-size:15px; } .yr { font-size:18px; } }

  /* ---------- illustration motion ---------- */
  .art g[class] { transform-box:view-box; }
  @keyframes bob     { 50% { transform:translateY(-3px); } }
  @keyframes breathe { 50% { transform:translateY(-1.5px) scaleY(1.008); } }
  @keyframes walk    { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) } 25% { transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-1deg) } 75% { transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(1deg) } }
  @keyframes dig     { 50% { transform:translateY(3px) rotate(4deg); } }
  @keyframes nod     { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 40% { transform:rotate(4deg) } 60% { transform:rotate(3deg) } }
  @keyframes beard   { 50% { transform:rotate(-5deg); } }
  @keyframes gesture { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 50% { transform:rotate(-10deg) } }
  @keyframes swing   { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 45% { transform:rotate(-40deg) } 60% { transform:rotate(6deg) } }
  @keyframes plant   { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 50% { transform:rotate(16deg) } }
  @keyframes pour    { 0%,15%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 40%,70% { transform:rotate(14deg) } }
  @keyframes sip     { 0%,20%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 45%,65% { transform:rotate(-28deg) } }
  @keyframes stir    { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-8deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(12deg) } }
  @keyframes rake    { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-10deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(14deg) } }
  @keyframes sway    { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-0.6deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(0.8deg) } }
  @keyframes flicker { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1,1) } 30% { transform:scale(1.06,1.18) } 60% { transform:scale(.95,.9) } 80% { transform:scale(1.03,1.1) } }
  @keyframes steam   { 0% { transform:translateY(10px) scaleY(.6); opacity:0 } 30% { opacity:.9 } 100% { transform:translateY(-50px) scaleY(1.1); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes fall    { 0% { offset-distance:0%; opacity:0 } 8% { opacity:1 } 92% { opacity:1 } 100% { offset-distance:100%; opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes windy   { 0% { transform:translateX(-60px); opacity:0 } 40% { opacity:.9 } 100% { transform:translateX(120px); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes drift   { 50% { transform:translateX(30px); } }
  @keyframes drift2  { 50% { transform:translateX(-24px); } }
  @keyframes flap    { 50% { transform:scaleY(-.6); } }
  @keyframes fly     { 0% { transform:translate(-200px,20px) } 100% { transform:translate(1700px,-60px) } }
  @keyframes flag    { 0%,100% { transform:skewY(0) scaleX(1) } 50% { transform:skewY(3deg) scaleX(.94) } }
  @keyframes sail    { 50% { transform:scaleX(1.04); } }
  @keyframes boat    { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg) } 50% { transform:translateY(6px) rotate(1.2deg) } }
  @keyframes wave    { to { transform:translateX(40px); } }
  @keyframes wave2   { to { transform:translateX(-40px); } }
  @keyframes swingl  { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-4deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(4deg) } }
  @keyframes bubble  { 0% { transform:scale(.2); opacity:0 } 40% { opacity:1 } 100% { transform:scale(1.4); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes glow    { 0%,100% { opacity:.7 } 50% { opacity:1 } }
  @keyframes pendulum { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-9deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(9deg) } }
  @keyframes page    { 0%,55%,100% { transform:scaleX(1) } 70% { transform:scaleX(-1) } 85% { transform:scaleX(-1) } }
  @keyframes ball    { 0% { offset-distance:0% } 100% { offset-distance:100% } }
  @keyframes dropin  { 0% { transform:translateY(-14px); opacity:0 } 30% { opacity:1 } 100% { transform:translateY(30px); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes pourleaf { 0% { offset-distance:0%; opacity:0 } 15% { opacity:1 } 100% { offset-distance:100%; opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes brew    { 0% { opacity:.05; transform:scale(.3) } 60%,100% { opacity:.95; transform:scale(1) } }
  @keyframes dunk    { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) } 50% { transform:translateY(-34px) } }
  @keyframes dunkarm { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 50% { transform:rotate(-6deg) } }
  @keyframes scoopa  { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 50% { transform:rotate(18deg) } }
  @keyframes train   { 0% { transform:translateX(-700px) } 100% { transform:translateX(1500px) } }
  @keyframes ripple  { 0% { transform:scale(.6); opacity:.9 } 100% { transform:scale(8.5); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes floatleaf { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(-7deg) } 50% { transform:rotate(9deg) } }
  @keyframes dropleaf { 0% { transform:translate(-160px,-330px) rotate(-40deg) scale(2.6); opacity:0 } 12% { opacity:.95 }
                         38% { transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0) scale(1); opacity:1 } 44%,100% { transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes toss    { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) rotate(0) } 40% { transform:translateY(-46px) rotate(160deg) } 60% { transform:translateY(-40px) rotate(220deg) } }
  .bob{animation:bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite} .breathe{animation:breathe 3.6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .walk{animation:walk 1.1s ease-in-out infinite} .dig{animation:dig 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
  .nod{animation:nod 4.2s ease-in-out infinite} .beard{animation:beard 3s ease-in-out infinite}
  .gesture{animation:gesture 3.4s ease-in-out infinite} .swing{animation:swing 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
  .plant{animation:plant 2.2s ease-in-out infinite} .pour{animation:pour 4s ease-in-out infinite}
  .sip{animation:sip 5s ease-in-out infinite} .sip2{animation:sip 6s ease-in-out infinite -2s}
  .stir{animation:stir 1.3s ease-in-out infinite} .stir2{animation:stir 1.3s ease-in-out infinite -.65s}
  .rake{animation:rake 2.2s ease-in-out infinite} .sway{animation:sway 6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .flicker{animation:flicker .9s ease-in-out infinite} .steam{animation:steam 3.2s ease-out infinite}
  .fall{animation-name:fall; animation-timing-function:ease-in-out; animation-iteration-count:infinite; offset-rotate:auto 40deg;}
  .windy{animation:windy 5s ease-in-out infinite} .drift{animation:drift 14s ease-in-out infinite} .drift2{animation:drift2 18s ease-in-out infinite}
  .flap{animation:flap .5s ease-in-out infinite} .fly{animation:fly 26s linear infinite}
  .flag{animation:flag 2.6s ease-in-out infinite} .sail{animation:sail 3s ease-in-out infinite}
  .boat{animation:boat 4.5s ease-in-out infinite} .wave{animation:wave 3s linear infinite} .wave2{animation:wave2 4s linear infinite}
  .swing-l{animation:swingl 3s ease-in-out infinite} .toss{animation:toss 1.6s ease-in-out infinite} .ripple{animation:ripple 5.2s ease-out infinite} .floatleaf{animation:floatleaf 7s ease-in-out infinite} .dropleaf{animation:dropleaf 5.2s ease-in infinite} .train{animation:train 9s linear infinite} .pendulum{animation:pendulum 2s ease-in-out infinite} .page{animation:page 6s ease-in-out infinite} .ball{animation:ball 3.6s linear infinite} .dropin{animation:dropin 1.6s ease-in infinite} .pourleaf{animation:pourleaf 1.6s ease-in infinite} .brew{animation:brew 6s ease-out infinite} .dunk{animation:dunk 2.4s ease-in-out infinite} .dunkarm{animation:dunkarm 2.4s ease-in-out infinite} .scoopa{animation:scoopa 1.8s ease-in-out infinite} .bubble{animation:bubble 1.6s ease-out infinite} .glow{animation:glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
  /* painted scenes */
  @keyframes kb     { 0% { transform:scale(1.0) translate(0,0) } 100% { transform:scale(1.06) translate(-14px,-8px) } }
  @keyframes breathp { 0%,100% { transform:scaleY(1) } 50% { transform:scaleY(1.007) } }
  @keyframes steamp { 0% { transform:translateY(20px) scale(.7,.5); opacity:0 } 25% { opacity:.65 } 100% { transform:translateY(-70px) scale(1.2,1.15); opacity:0 } }
  @keyframes mistA  { 0%,100% { transform:translateX(-40px) } 50% { transform:translateX(90px) } }
  @keyframes mistB  { 0%,100% { transform:translateX(60px) } 50% { transform:translateX(-70px) } }
  @keyframes glowp  { 0%,100% { opacity:.75; transform:scale(1) } 25% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1.08) } 55% { opacity:.6; transform:scale(.95) } 80% { opacity:.9; transform:scale(1.04) } }
  @keyframes sunp   { 50% { opacity:.55; transform:scale(1.08) } }
  .kb{animation:kb 28s ease-in-out infinite alternate} .breathp{animation:breathp 4.5s ease-in-out infinite}
  .steamp{animation:steamp 4s ease-out infinite} .mistA{animation:mistA 26s ease-in-out infinite} .mistB{animation:mistB 32s ease-in-out infinite}
  .glowp{animation:glowp 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; mix-blend-mode:screen} .sunp{animation:sunp 9s ease-in-out infinite}
  .scene.painted .art { background:#d8c49c; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .art * { animation:none !important; } }

.mapview { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; will-change:opacity; }
.mapview-svg { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }
.mp-route { stroke-dasharray:1; stroke-dashoffset:1; opacity:0; }
.mp-hl { fill:#E7503F; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-dasharray:2 2.5; stroke-linejoin:round; opacity:0; }
.mp-place { opacity:0; }
.mp-dot { fill:#E7503F; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:2; }
.mp-lab { font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight:700; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:.02em; fill:#23374B; text-anchor:middle;
 }
.mp-ship { opacity:0; }
.mp-place.big .mp-lab { font-size:34px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; fill:#fff; }
.mp-place.big .mp-dot { fill:none; stroke:#fff; stroke-width:2.4; }

.cups { position:relative; z-index:3; background:#E7EEF8; }
.cups-stage { position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow:visible; }
.cups-canvas { position:absolute; left:0; top:-100vh; width:100%; height:200vh; display:block; pointer-events:none; }
.cups-head { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:4.5vh; text-align:center; z-index:2; pointer-events:none; }
.cups-title { margin:0; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:22px; color:#1f2024; transition:opacity .35s; }
.cups-legend { margin-top:6px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:13px; color:#3a3a3a; transition:opacity .35s; }
.cups-legend .cup-ico { vertical-align:-3px; }
.cups-fact { max-width:560px; margin:14px auto 0; transition:opacity .35s; }
.cups-fact-big { margin:0; font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight:700; font-size:19px; line-height:1.3; color:#1f2024; }
.cups-fact-big:empty { display:none; }
.cups-fact-note { margin:5px 0 0; font-family:Tahoma, Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif; font-size:12px; color:#6b6666; }
.cups-tip { position:absolute; z-index:4; pointer-events:none; background:#fff; border:1px solid #ddd; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12); padding:8px 11px;
  font-family:Tahoma, Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif; font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.4; color:#2b2b2b; max-width:250px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s; }
.cups-tip b { color:#567698; }
.cups-cards { position:relative; margin-top:-100vh; padding:165vh 0 70vh; z-index:3; }
.cupcard { width:380px; max-width:calc(100vw - 60px); margin:0 auto 125vh; background:#23374B; padding:18px 22px; box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.cupcard:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.cupcard p { margin:0; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:16px; line-height:1.45; text-align:center; color:#000; }
@media (max-width:900px) { .cupcard { margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; } }

.paths { position:relative; z-index:3; background:#E7EEF8; padding:14vh 6vw 16vh; text-align:center; }
.paths h2 { margin:0 0 18px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:42px; color:#1f1f1f; }
.paths p { max-width:640px; margin:0 auto 16px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:18px; line-height:1.6; color:#2b2b2b; }
.ch-row { display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:3vw; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:9vh; }
.ch { background:none; border:0; padding:0; cursor:pointer; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:220px; font:inherit; }
.ch-bubble { position:relative; display:inline-block; min-width:190px; padding:15px 22px; border:2.2px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius:40px; background:#E7EEF8;
  font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:.5px; color:#1f1f1f; transition:background .25s, color .25s, border-color .25s; margin-bottom:34px; }
.ch-bubble::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:-13px; width:22px; height:22px; background:inherit; border-right:2.2px solid #1f1f1f; border-bottom:2.2px solid #1f1f1f;
  transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg); transition:inherit; }
.ch:hover .ch-bubble, .ch:focus-visible .ch-bubble { background:#E7503F; color:#fff; }
.ch:hover .ch-bubble::after { border-color:#1f1f1f; }
.ch-svg { width:200px; height:auto; overflow:visible; transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1); }
.ch:hover .ch-svg { transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-2deg); }
.ch-body { animation:chbob 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.ch:nth-child(2) .ch-body { animation-delay:-.9s } .ch:nth-child(3) .ch-body { animation-duration:1.6s } .ch:nth-child(4) .ch-body { animation-delay:-2.2s }
.ch-head { animation:chnod 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes chbob { 50% { transform:translateY(-4px); } }
@keyframes chnod { 0%,100% { transform:rotate(0) } 40% { transform:rotate(2.5deg) } 70% { transform:rotate(-2deg) } }
.ch-steam { animation:chsteam 3s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes chsteam { 0% { transform:translateY(8px); opacity:0 } 30% { opacity:.8 } 100% { transform:translateY(-16px); opacity:0 } }
.ch-leaf { animation:chleaf 6s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; }
@keyframes chleaf { 50% { transform:translate(-8px,10px) rotate(25deg); } }
.ch-cheer { animation:chcheer 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes chcheer { 50% { transform:rotate(-10deg); } }
.ch-zap { animation:chzap .8s steps(2) infinite; }
@keyframes chzap { 50% { opacity:.2; } }
.ch-sprout { animation:chsprout 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes chsprout { 50% { transform:rotate(8deg) scale(1.08); } }
.ch-rise { animation:chrise 4s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes chrise { 0% { transform:translateY(20px); opacity:0 } 30% { opacity:1 } 100% { transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(60deg); opacity:0 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .paths * { animation:none !important; } }

.journey { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; background:#e9eee8; opacity:0; visibility:hidden; transition:opacity .6s ease, visibility 0s .6s; }
.journey.open { opacity:1; visibility:visible; transition:opacity .6s ease; }
.jr-scroll { position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; overflow-x:hidden; overscroll-behavior:contain; }
.jr-stage { position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow:hidden; }
.jr-spacer { height:420vh; }
.jr-sky { position:absolute; inset:0; background:#e9eee8; }
.jr-track { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; height:100%; width:400vw; will-change:transform; }
.jr-land { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block; }
.jr-land g[class] { transform-box:view-box; }
.jr-panel { position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100vw; height:100%; }
.jr-intro { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; padding-top:20vh; }
.jr-intro h2 { margin:0; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:64px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#2b2b2b; text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.8); }
.jr-hint { margin-top:14px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-size:15px; color:#3a3a3a; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
.jr-mouse { width:20px; height:32px; border:2px solid #3a3a3a; border-radius:12px; position:relative; }
.jr-mouse::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:50%; top:6px; width:3px; height:7px; background:#3a3a3a; border-radius:2px; transform:translateX(-50%); animation:jrwheel 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes jrwheel { 50% { transform:translate(-50%,8px); opacity:.2; } }
.jr-cardwrap { position:absolute; left:52%; top:9vh; transform:translateX(-50%); width:min(400px, 70vw); text-align:center; }
.jr-cardwrap h3 { margin:0 0 14px; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:34px; color:#2b2b2b; text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.85); }
.jr-card { margin:0 !important; box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(40,30,20,.18); }
.jr-card p { font-size:16px !important; }
.jr-ico { display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-top:14px; }
.jr-ico svg { width:110px; height:55px; filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.8)); }
.jr-walker { position:absolute; bottom:4vh; left:50%; width:min(190px, 24vw); transform:translateX(-50%); will-change:left; }
.jr-walker .ch-svg { width:100%; }
.jr-walker.walking .ch-body { animation:jrwalk .45s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes jrwalk { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) rotate(0) } 25% { transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-1.5deg) } 75% { transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(1.5deg) } }
.jr-tea { transition:fill .8s ease; }
.jr-teachip { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:calc(4vh + min(190px,24vw) * 1.6); transform:translateX(-50%); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:7px 14px; border:2px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius:30px;
  background:#fff; font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.5px; color:#1f1f1f; opacity:0; transition:opacity .4s, left .1s linear; white-space:nowrap; }
.jr-teachip i { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:#ece3b8; border:1.5px solid #1f1f1f; transition:background .8s; }
.jr-back { position:absolute; left:24px; top:22px; z-index:3; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 18px; border:2px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius:30px; background:#fff; cursor:pointer;
  font-family:'Aleo',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; color:#1f1f1f; transition:background .2s, color .2s; }
.jr-back:hover, .jr-back:focus-visible { background:#E7503F; color:#fff; }
.jr-back span { font-size:18px; line-height:1; }
.jr-dots { position:absolute; right:26px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.jr-dots i { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid #1f1f1f; background:transparent; transition:background .3s; }
.jr-dots i.on { background:#E7503F; border-color:#E7503F; }
.ch.jumping .ch-svg { animation:chjump .55s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1); }
@keyframes chjump { 40% { transform:translateY(-46px) scale(1.04); } 100% { transform:translateY(0); } }
body.jr-lock { overflow:hidden; }
@media (max-width:700px) { .jr-intro h2 { font-size:44px; } .jr-cardwrap { left:58%; top:7vh; } }

.jr-land .spin { animation:jrspin 40s linear infinite; }
@keyframes jrspin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } }

  /* cards: dark background, white text */
  .card, .cupcard { background:#23374B !important; }
  .card p, .cupcard p { color:#fff !important; }
  /* Aleo: body text regular, every title bold */
  .ch-year, .ch-sub, .article-col h2, .article-col h2 b, .article-col h2 span, .chartcard h3, .cups-title, .paths h2,
  .jr-intro h2, .jr-cardwrap h3, .ch-bubble, .cc-big { font-weight:700 !important; }
  .card p, .article-col p, .cupcard p, .paths p, .jr-card p, .cc-note, .cc-ax, .cc-legend, .cups-legend { font-weight:400; }
  /* titles: Bree Serif bold · paragraphs: Tahoma regular */
  .ch-year, .ch-sub, .article-col h2, .article-col h2 b, .article-col h2 span, .chartcard h3, .cups-title, .paths h2,
  .jr-intro h2, .jr-cardwrap h3 { font-family:'Bree Serif', Georgia, serif !important; font-weight:700 !important; }
  .card p, .article-col p, .cupcard p, .paths p, .jr-card p, .cc-legend, .cc-legend em, .cc-legend span { font-family:Tahoma, Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif !important; font-weight:400 !important; }
  .cc-legend span b { font-family:Tahoma, Verdana, Geneva, sans-serif !important; font-weight:700 !important; }
